title: 凪の砂海と、潮騒の弔い鐘
author: 潮騒 ミナト

en.title: The Still Sand-Sea and the Knell of the Tides
en.premise: In a mysterious village, the sea vanishes as if it were a dream, revealing a shimmering desert of silver salt. An ancient legend tells of a phantom oasis that appears there—a sanctuary where the dead gather. Armed with a 'secret map' left by his late father, a young man ventures into the momentary void left by the receding tide, desperate to call back the one he loved and lost.

zh.title: 凪之砂海与潮汐的丧钟
zh.premise: 有一个不可思议的村庄，那里的海水会像谎言般消失，显现出银白色的盐之沙漠。那里流传着一个古老的传说：在这片土地上，会出现一个死者聚集的幻之绿洲。一名青年手持亡父留下的“秘密地图”，试图在潮汐退去的那一瞬空白之中，唤回他失去的最爱之人。
